title: Tôi không thể tìm thấy hướng dẫn viên du lịch
englishTitle: I cannot find the tour guide
pronunciation: Toi khong the tim thay huong dan vien du lich
summary: For telling staff you are at the meeting area but cannot find the guide.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Use it with a tour booking, ticket, chat thread, or meeting-point sign in view.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the booking or meeting point after the phrase so staff can match the time, company, or guide name.

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi không thể tìm thấy hướng dẫn viên du lịch
phrases.english: I cannot find the tour guide
phrases.pronunciation: Toi khong the tim thay huong dan vien du lich

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Tôi không thể tìm thấy means I cannot find; hướng dẫn viên du lịch means the tour guide.

breakdown.vietnamese: Tôi không thể tìm thấy hướng dẫn viên du lịch
breakdown.english: I cannot find the tour guide

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Tour meeting place, start time, and send meeting point phrases help when the guide is not visible yet.

phrases.vietnamese: Chuyến đi gặp nhau ở đâu?
phrases.pronunciation: Chuyen di gap nhau o dau

phrases.vietnamese: Chuyến tham quan bắt đầu lúc mấy giờ?
phrases.english: What time does the tour start?
phrases.pronunciation: Chuyen tham quan bat dau luc may gio

phrases.vietnamese: Vui lòng gửi cho tôi điểm tập trung
phrases.english: Please send me the meeting point
phrases.pronunciation: Vui long gui cho toi diem tap trung

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at hotel lobbies, ticket desks, attraction entrances, bus pickup points, and tour counters.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: The next useful detail is usually the tour company, guide name, start time, or meeting point.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Tour booking, entrance, English guide, tour meeting place, and book a tour phrases cover the next sightseeing handoff.
